$comment: cmux.agentPane.style/1: the CSS custom properties a person's agent-pane/theme.css (and a look add-on's) may set, on :root only. They are paint (color, fill, edge and corner) and motion (duration and easing: how long and on which curve the chat's own transitions run, never what moves). None moves a box, so a look applied or hot reloaded never shifts the transcript. Type, width and spacing are settings (agentPane.display.*), because the transcript's height estimate reads them (model.ts); a stylesheet that set them would make rows jump when they are measured. The colors the host pushes from the theme (--agent-text, --agent-accent and the rest of shared/theme.ts cssVariables) are inline styles on the root, so a stylesheet cannot beat them: set those with the theme file's `colors` and `appearance.surfaces.agentPane`. webviews scripts/check-look-addons.ts holds the pane's stylesheets and every add-on in examples/looks to this file: each token is declared on :root in `owner` (or, for a token with no value of its own, read there with a fallback: `var(--token, today's value)`), nowhere else but `alsoScopedIn`, never pushed by the host, and an add-on sets nothing else; a duration is 0 to 600 ms and an easing a cubic-bezier() (x within 0 to 1), linear or linear(), never !important. Animations off and Reduce Motion (data-cmux-motion / data-agent-motion off or reduced on the root) put cmux's own motion values back above any look (gen-motion-scale.py). Docs: docs/cmux-next/look-addons.md.
status: draft: shapes are refined with the first outside look before the interface is public

tokens.name: --cv-text
tokens.about: The transcript's body text: prompts, replies and headings.

tokens.name: --cv-text-muted
tokens.about: Secondary transcript text: meta lines, the live run's words. Tool rows and Worked for draw --cv-activity-text.

tokens.name: --cv-activity-text
tokens.about: Background activity: tool rows and Worked for (58% of the text by default). A look on a light paper of its own sets it, often to its --cv-text-muted, to hold 4.5:1.

tokens.name: --cv-text-dim
tokens.about: The quietest transcript text: timestamps and hints.

tokens.name: --cv-link
tokens.about: Links in replies.

tokens.name: --agent-link
tokens.about: Links in the rest of the pane (chips, cards, the composer).

tokens.name: --cv-card-fill
tokens.about: The fill of the card level in the pane: tool output, edit, error and permission cards, plans, the subagent card (design/chat-surfaces.md). Code blocks keep --cv-codeblock-bg. Unset: the card level, the theme's text at 4%.

tokens.name: --cv-card-ring
tokens.about: The hairline around those cards (none under appearance.borders: none). Unset: the card level's line, the theme's text at 10%.

tokens.name: --cv-user-bubble-tint
tokens.about: The prompt bubble's glass tint. Unset: the theme's text at 14%.

tokens.name: --cv-user-bubble-edge
tokens.about: The prompt bubble's hairline edge. Unset: none (transparent).

tokens.name: --cv-user-bubble-text
tokens.about: The prompt bubble's text, for a filled bubble (white on a blue pill). Its quiet lines (a quote, Show more) take it at 88%, a skill's /name and inline code follow it, and with --cv-user-bubble-tint set it keeps that tint under Reduce Transparency. Unset: the transcript's text (--cv-text).

tokens.name: --cv-user-bubble-radius
tokens.about: The prompt bubble's corner radius. Unset: 12 px at the chat's text scale. A corner never changes the bubble's box.

tokens.name: --cv-code-edge-fade
tokens.about: How far a code block's long line fades at the card's right edge while more of it lies past. Unset: no fade, a hard edge. Paint only: the line's box does not change.

tokens.name: --cv-composer-icon-radius
tokens.about: The corner of the round composer's + button (Studio's paperclip) and its hover highlight; 50% draws a circle. Read only by the in-box composer looks (Studio, Codex), never by Claude's one-line look. Unset: the app's button corner, --ds-radius-control. A corner never changes the button's box.

tokens.name: --cmux-motion-quick
tokens.about: Duration, 0 to 600 ms (ms or s). Unset: 80 ms: a hover's color, a fade in place (a chip, a check). Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.

tokens.name: --cmux-motion-micro
tokens.about: Duration, 0 to 600 ms (ms or s). Unset: 120 ms: a popover, menu or tooltip entering; a small control's change. Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.

tokens.name: --cmux-motion-standard
tokens.about: Duration, 0 to 600 ms (ms or s). Unset: 180 ms: a panel or card entering; a row's move. Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.

tokens.name: --cmux-motion-large
tokens.about: Duration, 0 to 600 ms (ms or s). Unset: 240 ms: a sheet, drawer or the chat switch. Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.

tokens.name: --cmux-motion-settle
tokens.about: Duration, 0 to 600 ms (ms or s). Unset: 180 ms: a fold or Show more growing or shrinking into its new height. Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.

tokens.name: --cmux-motion-arrive
tokens.about: Duration, 0 to 600 ms (ms or s). Unset: the chat's move step (180 ms, after ui.animationSpeed): a row arriving in a running turn (a thought, a tool call, the reply's next block) fading in, and the rows it moves. 0 lands each row in place in its frame. Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.

tokens.name: --cmux-motion-send
tokens.about: Duration, 0 to 600 ms (ms or s). Unset: 0 ms: a sent prompt's room, bubble and the thread's rise (instant by default). Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.

tokens.name: --cmux-ease-out
tokens.about: Easing: cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2) with x1 and x2 within 0 to 1, linear or linear(...). Unset: cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.58, 1): anything entering. Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.

tokens.name: --cmux-ease-spring
tokens.about: Easing: cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2) with x1 and x2 within 0 to 1, linear or linear(...). Unset: a linear() spring: a selection that travels, over --cmux-motion-standard. Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.

tokens.name: --cmux-ease-settle
tokens.about: Easing: cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2) with x1 and x2 within 0 to 1, linear or linear(...). Unset: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1): a fold settling into its height, never past it. Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.

tokens.name: --cmux-ease-send
tokens.about: Easing: cubic-bezier(x1, y1, x2, y2) with x1 and x2 within 0 to 1, linear or linear(...). Unset: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1): a sent prompt's motion. Off or reduced motion keeps cmux's value.
